t0005-01.gloss: An opened case keeps a key beside an untouched lock.
t0005-01.rival_reading: A program worker could open an old case repeatedly while sorting supplies; wear around a lock does not show that an office concealed a failed response.

t0005-02.gloss: A planting packet survives beside an instruction panel removed from its sack.
t0005-02.rival_reading: A county office could remove obsolete handling directions during a routine cleanup; the missing panel does not prove a program malfunction.
